decision11.why: C03 implements the integral term in sampled form, and R-M02 (sampled accumulation) is already its prerequisite. The continuous integral explains it but is not needed to build or verify it.
The derivative term is a finite difference, covered by R-M02. m-derivative is already on the path through other skills.
Odometry sums sampled increments (R-M02 is its prerequisite). Numerical integration theory is useful context, not required.
